signature_verification.note: The free public door checks the Ed25519 half. The post-quantum halves are implemented and verified in our own site tooling (src/lib/psi-pqc.ts, src/lib/psi-lms.ts) and are NOT checked by the published verifier package — measured 2026-11-03: the installed dist contains 0 references to pq_alg or pq_value.

canonicalization: PSI-SEAL/1.0.0 key-sorted JSON — this verifier's own canonical form. Not RFC 8785: measured 2026-11-03, a string containing U+2028 digests bacc0479771c7059 under the published jcs() and 45731493d4bc3231 under RFC 8785, and the published jcs() emits null for NaN where RFC 8785 refuses the input.

anchor.note: A proof is reported as pending until a real Bitcoin block includes it. No anchor is ever reported as confirmed without a txid returned by a block explorer.

interop: IETF RFC 9943 (SCITT architecture) — JSON bridge view, not COSE conformance
C2PA — informative view, not a signed manifest
merkle_profile: PSI-R8-SHA256 — raw 32-byte node concatenation, odd node promoted, no domain-separation prefixes, chronological leaf order, for receipts issued from 2026-10-13. Not RFC 6962: over the same two leaf nodes the published verifier returns ae2c68c7ffc19e0f while an RFC 6962 tree head over the same nodes is 1cb7025aaf86ac63 (measured 2026-11-03). An RFC 6962 profile would change every existing root and is a versioned target, not the shipped behaviour.
